newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Yields seen mixed at Portugal bond sales.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Yields seen mixed at Portugal bond sales.

text.p: Five- and 10-year Portuguese state bond prices could ease at an auction on Monday, reflecting the recent market correction and the escudo's retreat, but demand is expected to be strong for three-year paper, analysts said.

"The five and 10 years are going to feel the impact of the decline in the secondary market in recent days and the correction of the escudo, despite the fact that demand will be good from funds and institutions," said one fixed-income trader.
The Institute for Public Credit Management is offering 25 billion escudos ($152.8 million) of March 2000 bonds, 25 billion of March 2002 and 25 billion of February 2007 paper.
Auction results will be issued around 1100 GMT.
Bids for the 10-year paper were seen between 6.65 and 6.83 percent, compared with the 6.615 percent average at the last such sale on January 21.
Bids for the March 2002 were put at 5.70 to 5.85 percent, against 5.70 percent at the January 21 sale.
The March 2000 paper was seen drawing bids at between 5.25 and 5.50 percent, against 5.406 percent at the last sale on Jasnuary 14.
